concerns.text: FR-001 requires extending 16 specific environments. T013b mentions 'programmatic application' but lacks a task explicitly iterating over or listing the 16 target environment IDs to ensure all are covered, risking partial implementation.

FR-001 mandates a configurable step N with a default of 50%. T013 implements the shift logic but no task explicitly covers parsing the configuration for 'N' or enforcing the 50% default value, leaving the requirement unimplemented.

FR-001 Acceptance Scenario 2 requires detecting a statistically significant performance drop (p < 0.05). T014b (statistical test) is misplaced in the env file and T014 only logs a warning. No task exists to execute the statistical comparison and flag the result as required by the spec.

FR-002 requires output validation against a machine-readable rule schema. T020 creates the validator, but no task explicitly links the generator's runtime output to this validator before returning the explanation, creating a gap in the 'validated' requirement.

FR-002 Acceptance Scenario 1 mandates a 200-token limit with failure flagging. T021 (inference) and T023 (fallback) do not include a task for token counting, truncation, or the specific 'exceeds limit' flagging logic.

FR-005 requires a mixed-effects model accounting for nested data (runs within seeds). T036 vaguely mentions 'mixed-effects model' without specifying the library (statsmodels), the model formula for nesting, or the output format for effect size verification.

SC-004 requires measuring the rate of successful explanation generation. No task exists to aggregate success/failure counts from T021 (timeouts) and T023 (fallbacks) to calculate and report this specific metric.

Constitution Principle VII requires test set dynamics to be fixed and unknown to the agent. No task exists to implement the logic that separates test set configuration from training/evolution configuration to enforce this independence.

T015b ('Implement sensitivity analysis and configuration adjustment mechanism') appears to be scope creep. The spec lists sensitivity analysis as an Assumption to verify robustness, not a functional requirement to auto-adjust configuration. This task may implement unrequested functionality.
